title: Chapter 197: Efficient Slaughter Of Flying Dragons
content:
Chapter 197: Efficient Slaughter Of Flying Dragons

Naga looked at host No. 3 curiously and said, "So, the nobles are not short of troops now, but resources, right?"

"Yes, because our tribe has been in a closed environment for a long time, and we urgently need luck to improve the strength of the army!"

Wu Qing explained it truthfully and falsely.

For the reclusive races in this world, Wu Qing did not know how they were reclusive, but he knew some common sense. These reclusive races are generally in some relatively closed environments and are not disturbed by the outside world.

Wu Qing sometimes wondered if the mysterious underground world was a gathering place for reclusive races.

However, the underground world is not a peaceful place at first glance. If it is such a reclusive place, it is better not to be reclusive.

"Okay! Tomorrow I will let Nagalong be your guide, and you can fight the demons alone!"

"I will order the withdrawal of a part of the strategic reserve luck beads, and you will send someone to transport them tomorrow!"

"Good luck to you!"

Naga agreed to Wu Qing's proposal and decided to use the strategic reserve luck beads of the Naga tribe.

As long as the Zerg reinforcements annihilate more demon troops and relieve the pressure on the Naga defense line, the impact of Naga's withdrawal of some strategic reserve luck beads will not be great.

"Thank you for your understanding and support, elder!"

After the No. 3 host left, Naga pondered for a while and issued several important orders in succession.

The evil god camp sent a strong army as an exception, and the Naga tribe also had to prepare early. After the news was finally confirmed, it was necessary to report to the tribe.

...

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the body, and he ordered the Queen of the Bugs to absorb all the luck beads harvested from the Naga tribe into the system and convert them into the system's gas resources.

Now that the distribution of some of the bear goblin tribe's military forces has been explored, Wu Qing is ready to let the Zerg take the initiative to attack before they all gather together.

The most effective Zerg army to deal with a small number of enemy troops scattered everywhere is the flying dragon.

The Zerg flying dragons fly in the air, are fast, attack swiftly, and come and go freely. Wu Qing plans to use the flying dragons to first clear out the ordinary army of the bear goblins, and then have a decisive battle with the army directly under the green department of the spirit god.

Naga didn't know why this army directly under the green department came here, but Wu Qing knew very well that the spirit god had already set his sights on the Zerg. The bear goblins would do their best to do what the gods wanted to do, even if they broke the routine.

A strong enemy means that defeating them can get more resources, and the Zerg can accept a larger loss.

As long as the Zerg's troops have enough resources, they can upgrade their stars at any time. To deal with such a strong enemy, the Zerg only needs to build a strong army.

The system converts all the luck beads into gas resources, with nearly five million gas. If all the flying dragons are hatched, 50,000 flying dragons can be added.

But the gas resources cannot be used in this way. The Zerg army cannot rely on large numbers alone, and still needs a part of quality troops to support it.

Wu Qing first increased the number of flying dragons to 30,000, and upgraded some of them, increasing the number of three-star flying dragons to 10, adding 100 two-star flying dragons and 3,000 one-star flying dragons.

With these high-star flying dragons, the attacking ability of the entire flying dragon group is stronger. No matter what kind of enemy they face, they have the strength to fight. Facing ordinary troops, the efficiency of killing enemies will be greatly increased.

What Wu Qing needs now is the efficiency of killing enemies. It costs so much to upgrade, just to let these flying dragons quickly eliminate the enemy, plunder resources, and accumulate resources for the upgrade of other arms.

Other Zerg arms will not move for the time being. It will take some time for the bear goblin tribe to gather its forces, and the Zerg tribe still has time to deploy calmly.

This is the importance of intelligence. If the bear goblin tribe gathers a large army, 300,000 green troops directly under the green department, plus millions of ordinary troops of the bear goblin tribe, Wu Qing will also have a headache.

Wu Qing and the Queen discussed the battle plan in detail based on the intelligence of the bear goblins. Wu Qing did not go to rest until late at night.

…

Early the next morning, three thousand Heavenly Silkworm Knights who inherited the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Heavens Art were selected in the large city of the Tengu tribe, and continued their journey to the unknown city.

The transportation teams of the Great Xia Territory of Mengzhong City and the various territories of the alliance happily set off to return to the territory with personnel and supplies.

Among them, the number of refugees brought back by the Great Xia Territory exceeded 200,000. A large part of these refugees had to be resettled in Guangfu City first.

Guangfu City was a city captured by the Zerg. The Alliance army just got a little luck, but it didn't play much of a role.

Wu Qing allowed the various territories of the Alliance to station troops, but everyone would not bring the people of the territory here. The permanent population of this city in the future will all belong to the Great Xia Territory.

The current territories of the Alliance do not have the strength to occupy the territory outside the territory.

With the addition of more than 200,000 refugees, the population of Daxia Territory is approaching 300,000, making Daxia Territory the most populous territory in the alliance.

…

In the Zerg territory, 30,000 Zerg flying dragons gathered, accompanied by the No. 1 three-star host and 5 queens. Wu Qing also specially upgraded 10 three-star explosive mosquitoes to follow the action.

These special troops are all for dealing with emergencies. The bugbear tribe even sent the green department's direct troops. There may be other unexpected things, so we must be prepared.

The huge group of Zerg flying dragons no longer concealed their tracks and flew directly to the bugbear tribe's garrison city discovered yesterday.

Many soldiers of the Alliance Army in Guangfu City saw a group of Zerg flying dragons flying in the distance. They thought they saw a rare bird migration scene and called their friends to come and watch.

In the underground world, the Zerg sent out yesterday's ground force lineup, and continued to fight the ghouls under the protection of the No. 2 three-star host and five queens.

If the ghouls were still in the same state as yesterday, Wu Qing would be ready to send more Zerg puppies and take the initiative to attack the ghouls.

Today, except for the transport host that transported supplies to the Naga territory, the Zerg did not send any more reinforcements. Those accumulated Zerg puppies can be put into the underground world to strengthen the offensive against the ghoul territory.

Wu Qing now has to do everything he can to plunder resources.

The Zerg reinforcements in the Naga city did not wait for the Zerg transport host to arrive. As soon as the sky got light, the No. 3 host urged Nagalong to lead the way and led the Zerg army out of the city and rushed towards today's goal.

Wu Qing needs this Zerg reinforcement in the Naga territory, so hurry up and clean up several more demon armies.

…

The flying speed of the Zerg dragon group is very fast. Flying in the air, they are not affected by the terrain and can go in a straight line. They soon arrived at the first city where the army of the bear goblins is stationed.

This is a small city, where more than 100,000 ordinary regular troops of the bear goblins are stationed, and there are soldiers of several races crowded in this city.

Although these soldiers of the evil god camp army are no longer normal intelligent races in spirit, they are still normal creatures in body, and they can't lack eating, drinking, defecating or urinating.

They all need the logistical support required by a normal army, which is why the army of the bear goblins can't gather all at once.

If there are too many troops and the logistical support can't keep up, there will be big problems.

This has led to the army of the bear goblins gathering in this area, but they are still scattered in different cities, and the real gathering place of the army is still under construction.

When the Zerg dragons flew at high speed, the soldiers of the evil god camp who had just woken up in this small town, like the soldiers of the Alliance Army in the Restoration City, were all looking at the strangeness, not realizing the danger was coming.

When a large group of terrifying dragons flew straight towards the city, the soldiers of the evil god camp finally saw the ferocious and terrifying template of the dragons and realized that something was wrong.

"Enemy attack!"

With a shrill cry that broke through the morning sky, the biological bombs of the Zerg dragons fell and poured into the city!

"Boom boom boom...! Boom boom...!"

Big explosions and countless small explosions sounded everywhere in the city, buildings collapsed, and people were blown away!

The whole city fell into chaos all of a sudden, and a large number of evil god camp soldiers disappeared in light!

The speed of the Zerg dragon group was extremely fast. Seeing that the city below had no defense, 30,000 Zerg dragons flew over the city at once, lowered their altitude and sprayed biological bombs. The violent explosion instantly submerged the entire small town!

The small town only had ordinary troops of the bear goblins. Many soldiers were not even fully equipped. Now was not wartime. They were suddenly attacked, and the evil god priest had no time to bless them.

Even if these evil god camp soldiers had extremely fanatical beliefs and were not afraid of death, they were useless. They were blown up by the biological bombs sprayed by the Zerg dragons and disappeared on the spot.

Those evil god camp soldiers who were still in various buildings were not spared. After the biological bombs exploded, they released groups of micro-biological bombs like killer bees, which would fly in from various gaps following the breath of life and then explode collectively!

The evil god camp soldiers in the small town had nowhere to hide, let alone organize a counterattack. The first three rounds of attacks by the Zerg dragon group almost wiped out most of the living forces in the city.

The evil god priest and the guards around him in the city were not strong. As soon as they appeared, they were eliminated by a one-star dragon with concentrated fire.

After several rounds of fierce attacks, the Zerg dragon group, under the command of the three-star host, attacked the surviving soldiers of the evil god camp.

Under the powerful detection ability of the three-star host, no one can escape its search.

The Zerg dragon group's surprise attack is about speed. In order not to delay time, they spared no firepower to attack the surviving soldiers of the evil god camp.

In just a few minutes, a small city that gathered hundreds of thousands of evil god camp troops became a ruin, without a single living thing.

The city that was just crowded now has no trace of life at all. It has all disappeared into light and become clean.
